control_evidence_kind_ck.name: control_evidence_kind_ck
control_evidence_kind_ck.value: ("control_evidence"."kind" <> 'file' OR "control_evidence"."artifact_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("control_evidence"."kind" <> 'link' OR "control_evidence"."url" IS NOT NULL)

data_principals_guardian_kind_ck.name: data_principals_guardian_kind_ck
data_principals_guardian_kind_ck.value: ("data_principals"."guardian_id" IS NULL) = ("data_principals"."guardian_kind" IS NULL) AND (NOT "data_principals"."is_child" OR "data_principals"."guardian_kind" = 'parent') AND ("data_principals"."is_child" OR "data_principals"."guardian_kind" IS DISTINCT FROM 'parent')

dpia_risks_scale_ck.name: dpia_risks_scale_ck
dpia_risks_scale_ck.value:
"dpia_risks"."likelihood" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "dpia_risks"."impact" BETWEEN 1 AND 5
          AND ("dpia_risks"."residual_likelihood" IS NULL OR "dpia_risks"."residual_likelihood" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
          AND ("dpia_risks"."residual_impact" IS NULL OR "dpia_risks"."residual_impact" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

dpias_period_ck.name: dpias_period_ck
dpias_period_ck.value: "dpias"."period_start" IS NULL OR "dpias"."period_end" IS NULL OR "dpias"."period_start" <= "dpias"."period_end"

risks_scores_ck.name: risks_scores_ck
risks_scores_ck.value:
"risks"."inherent_likelihood" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "risks"."inherent_impact" BETWEEN 1 AND 5
        AND "risks"."residual_likelihood" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "risks"."residual_impact" BETWEEN 1 AND 5
        AND "risks"."residual_likelihood" * "risks"."residual_impact" <= "risks"."inherent_likelihood" * "risks"."inherent_impact"

risks_accepted_ck.name: risks_accepted_ck
risks_accepted_ck.value: "risks"."status" <> 'accepted' OR ("risks"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "risks"."accepted_until" IS NOT NULL AND "risks"."acceptance_justification" IS NOT NULL)

remediation_tasks_subject_ck.name: remediation_tasks_subject_ck
remediation_tasks_subject_ck.value: ("remediation_tasks"."source" IN ('finding', 'manual')) OR ("remediation_tasks"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL AND "remediation_tasks"."gap_code" IS NOT NULL)

training_courses_content_ck.name: training_courses_content_ck
training_courses_content_ck.value: "training_courses"."content_url" IS NOT NULL OR "training_courses"."body" IS NOT NULL
